_metadata.description: Per-component preview harness that executes real React inside an isolated iframe, wired via @vrooli/iframe-bridge.

requirements.title: Per-component harness page renders the actual React component (not placeholder HTML)
requirements.description: API serves `GET /api/v1/preview/{component_id}` returning an HTML shell that imports the component's bundled source and mounts it via `ReactDOM.createRoot`. The shell calls `initIframeBridgeChild()` on load. Bundling approach (esbuild service vs pre-bundled chunks with dynamic import) is captured in `docs/RESEARCH.md` and chosen before slice 3 of Phase 4.

validation.notes: BAS flow `preview-renders-component` loads a known component, asserts the iframe DOM contains expected rendered output.

requirements.title: Reload-on-save: editor save triggers iframe NAV via the host bridge
requirements.description: After the editor PUT succeeds, the UI invokes the host-side `@vrooli/iframe-bridge` NAV message to reload the harness. Warm reload latency target is < 1s on a 50KB component on a developer-class machine.

validation.notes: BAS flow `edit-and-preview` edits a string in Monaco, saves, and asserts the iframe reflects the change.

requirements.title: Preview iframe is served same-origin from the library API with sandbox attributes
requirements.description: The harness page is served by the library's own API on a dedicated harness path so the bridge can inspect freely. The `<iframe>` carries the sandbox attribute set documented in `vrooli-ui-interop`; no third-party origins are loaded.

validation.notes: Handler test asserts harness route returns 200 with the expected origin; UI test asserts iframe sandbox attribute string.
